delivery.strategy: Pre-generated WebP srcset served directly through Cloudflare Workers Static Assets, without runtime image transformations.
delivery.fullSize: Includes the original width and original bytes. Smaller variants preserve proportions without cropping or enlargement.
delivery.cache: Content hashes in filenames allow one-year immutable caching through apps/saas/public/_headers.
delivery.maintenance: After changing an original or its dimensions, update this manifest, run the generation command, and commit the generated manifest and assets. Retain old variants so cached pages keep working.
